sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Column header tooltips name their column in bold, with the explanation below it. This applies to every column the script adds (derived, extracted and injected columns such as Event-Date, MB-Name, Recording of), and "Work" / "Perf." (WIP.1) show their full names there.

MusicBrainz's own columns now have a header tooltip too, saying what the column holds: Artist, Title, Catalog#, Country/Date, Format, Tracks, ISRCs, Rating and about 60 more. Where a name means different things the text fits the table: "Type" on an artist's Events page is the kind of event, on a release-group list the primary and secondary types. New setting "Explain MusicBrainz columns in header tooltips" (🎨 UI FEATURES, on). Not on other sites, whose columns these texts do not describe. A pageType can add or override texts with features.columnDescriptions.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed a test flake in discogs-links.spec.js ("in the history window: … a support link with its section"): it failed about 1 run in 28 when many tests ran in parallel. The help-centre window asks for the site's icon after the article answers. Under load that icon request (support.discogs.com/favicon.ico) arrived before the check that only the article was requested. The check now leaves the icon request out; icons have their own tests in popup-ext.spec.js. The userscript is unchanged.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Recording lists: the "Recording of" and "Performance attributes" column headers now read "Work" and "Perf.", so the two columns take less width. Hover a header to see its full name. Menus, the 📊 drop-down, exports and the Default Hidden Columns table still use the full names. To get the full names back in the headers, turn off the new setting "Short column header labels" (🎨 UI FEATURES, on by default).

Short header labels work for any column. A pageType gets its own with features.columnLabels; the built-in ones are in _COLUMN_LABELS. A saved table keeps each labelled column's name, so Load from Disk restores it.
